recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast collage featuring two central figures emerging from a massive mushroom cloud explosion, set against a dark, textured horizon with bold, condensed typography at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures integrated into the billowing smoke of the explosion
Mushroom cloud stem acting as a vertical axis for the composition
Dark, heavy typography anchoring the bottom third of the frame
High-contrast black and white palette creating a gritty, dramatic mood
coreInvariants: Grainy, film-like texture across all elements
Monochromatic color scheme with deep blacks and bright whites

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures are centered in the upper half, scaled to fit within the width of the cloud's cap.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white base of the explosion stem at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figures, move down the explosion stem to the large text, then back up to the top logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, overcast sky in the upper corners and dark water/ground at the very bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the core of the explosion and highlights on figures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue-grey tint within the bottom typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the explosion and the dark sky.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to grayscale with subtle cool-toned shadows

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are spaced widely to span the entire width of the composition
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A geometric, abstract glyph or logo is placed at the top center to balance the heavy text at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and aggressive feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary height and clean sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, grainy image of a large nuclear mushroom cloud explosion over a dark ocean at night. Integrate two urban-style male portraits into the top smoke clouds using a double-exposure effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed, bold sans-serif text in uppercase across the bottom. Use wide tracking and a dark, desaturated blue fill with a subtle black outline. Place a small geometric white logo at the top center.

verificationChecks: Are the figures blended naturally into the smoke?
Is the typography at the bottom extra-condensed and widely spaced?
Is there a consistent film grain texture throughout?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the figures within the smoke
Tracking width of the bottom text
Height of the mushroom cloud stem
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Unique brand logos or specific character glyphs
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeds into the grayscale palette.
Check that the text is legible despite the dark background.
Verify the grain doesn't obscure the primary subjects' faces.
Confirm the horizon line is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central vertical explosion motif with integrated portraits, a heavy grain filter, and wide-tracked condensed sans-serif typography at the base for a gritty urban aesthetic.
